newsitem.title: JAPAN: Denso sees higher 96/97 capital spending.
newsitem.headline: Denso sees higher 96/97 capital spending.

text.p: Denso Corp will increase its parent company capital investment for the business year ending March 1997 to 120 billion yen from a May forecast of 90 billion yen, a spokesman for Denso said on Tuesday.
Capital spending by Denso, which changed its name from Nippondenso Co Ltd on October 1 and is owned 23.1 percent by Toyota Motor Corp, totalled 80 billion yen in 1995/96.
The increased capital investment will be used for facilities for making car parts in line with the launch of Toyota's new models, and facilities for its new businesses such as cell phones.
